'''Clone Flight Squad Seven''', often simply referred to as '''Squad Seven''', was one of the most experienced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]]. This [[unit]] was composed entirely of [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] flying [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighters]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]], and was led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Davijaan/Legends|Davijaan]], also known as "Odd Ball." [[Squad/Legends|Squad]] Seven's fighters were painted a light gray with dark red markings to identify their squadron affiliation.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Arc-170_dive.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Squad Seven [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] dives into action during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].]]
Clone Flight Squad Seven characteristically flew gray and dark red-colored Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighters]] for the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Squad Seven's ARC-170 starfighters were given particular attention to armament and shielding, as well as enhanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] systems, making the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] formidable against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The squadron's V-wings were likewise highly maneuverable, allowing them to provide defensive support to the ARC-170s.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Clone Flight Squad Seven provided cover for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as they made their way to the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] from their home ship, [[Ro-ti-Mundi/Legends|''Ro-ti-Mundi'']]. Squad Seven V-wings fought off [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tri-fighters, Vulture droids, and deadly buzz droids, with some even getting as far as the Separatist flagship, however many were lost to enemy flak. Although Squad Seven suffered many casualties, especially to [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], their sacrifices allowed the two Jedi to board the ''Hand'' and rescue [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
[[File:CloneFlightSquadSevenVwings.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Squad Seven V-wings]]
After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], Squad Seven V-wings were called upon to escort the [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|personal shuttle]] of then [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine as it transported a critically wounded Darth Vader&mdash;formerly [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]&mdash;through the skies of Coruscant to the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Surgical Reconstruction Center]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although V-wings were included as part of the Galactic Navy's assets in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], it wasn't until the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' specifically labeled a miniature of a V-wing in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the game that the gray and dark red fighters were identified specifically as belonging to Squad Seven. The set also included a miniature of a Squad Seven ARC-170, as well.
